tl0001.name: Archivist Mara
tl0001.line: Dorian's last travel ledger is in the library. The court holds the key to his western route.

choices.label: Ask for the old route
choices.reply: Mara marks a safe path through the pale stones in Dorian's ledger. Carry the route west.

choices.label: Ask the king for aid
choices.reply: Mara suggests seeking Edmon's seal before leaving the city. The king can authorize help.

choices.label: Leave it for later
choices.reply: Mara closes the ledger. The western trail will have to be found without its guide.

tl0001.goal: Recover Dorian's route ledger and send Algoreth to the court with a usable lead.
tl0001.knowledge: Knows where the ledger points and which library record may corroborate it; does not know what awaits in Lorian.
tl0001.voice: Precise and helpful, careful to distinguish a record from a conclusion.

tl0001.name: King Edmon
tl0001.line: I am Alsperia's original king. I grant you a map and shelter; return with knowledge, not conquest.
tl0001.goal: Support the journey to Lorian while making clear that Algoreth travels under the crown's trust.
tl0001.knowledge: Knows the royal road and can provide a map, horse, and shelter; has not seen the Byzantem scrolls.
tl0001.voice: Measured and authoritative, welcoming without promising what he cannot know.

tl0001.name: Queen Alisande
tl0001.line: Edmon is my husband and king. His trust opens this road, and I expect you to honor it.
tl0001.goal: Protect the trust behind the expedition and ensure the scrolls are treated as a public responsibility.
tl0001.knowledge: Knows the court's obligations and the people affected by royal decisions; her knowledge of the road is limited to the records before her.
tl0001.voice: Warm, composed, and direct about responsibility.

tl0008.name: Scholar Inessa
tl0008.line: The route index was scraped where the western landmarks should be. I need the market ledger to restore the missing marks.

choices.label: Copy the rune index
choices.reply: Inessa copies the pale-stone marks into your field notes. Tessa can use them to avoid the watchpost.

choices.label: Seal the damaged leaf
choices.reply: Inessa seals the fragile page. You have the court's route, but the damaged landmarks remain uncertain.

tl0008.goal: Restore the western route index before it is carried into Mistwood.
tl0008.knowledge: Can compare the damaged index with the court copy; cannot guarantee that old waystones remain in place.
tl0008.voice: Analytical and patient, explaining uncertainty in concrete terms.

tl0008.name: Royal Scribe Oren
tl0008.line: Dorian's name appears in the oldest catalog. The entry says he feared the purpose of the traveller more than the road itself.
tl0008.goal: Find the oldest reliable entry about Dorian and warn the party to attend to its meaning.
tl0008.knowledge: Knows what the catalogue says and where it was copied from; has no firsthand knowledge of Dorian.
tl0008.voice: Formal and exact, with a scholar's respect for source records.

tl0015.name: Scout Tessa
tl0015.goal: Lead the party along the safest known trail while limiting the watcher's opportunity to follow.
tl0015.knowledge: Knows the road, pale stones, and hunters' lantern signal; does not know the stalker's origin or intent.
tl0015.voice: Practical, alert, and economical with words.
tl0015.line: We can shield the lantern and take the pale-stone bend, or leave the camp dark and move without its signal.

choices.label: Relight the shuttered lantern
choices.reply: You shield the lantern's flame. Its narrow beam marks a safe bend without lighting the whole camp.

choices.label: Keep the camp concealed
choices.reply: You leave the lantern shuttered. The camp stays hidden, but the road ahead remains uncertain.

responses.line: The hooded lantern and spare oil give us a quiet signal. You still choose whether to light it.
The rope and rations make the creek route practical. Ilya knows where to test the crossing.

tl0015.name: Hunter Fen
tl0015.goal: Protect the camp while giving travellers a usable route through the old wood.
tl0015.knowledge: Knows the marked path and how far the shuttered lantern can be seen; has not met the stalker.
tl0015.voice: Cautious and observant, describing signs instead of guesses.
tl0015.line: The pale stones are still there. A shielded flame will show the safe bend without carrying far through the trees.

responses.line: The lantern is shuttered again. Follow its short beam and stay on the pale stones; the camp remains dark behind you.
The lantern stays dark. I cannot promise the stalker has left the road, but the camp should remain concealed.

tl0015.name: Ranger Ilya
tl0015.role: Creekside pathfinder for the Mistwood hunters
tl0015.goal: Keep the camp hidden while helping travellers pass the stalker's patrol without using the lantern.
tl0015.knowledge: Reads broken reeds and shallow tracks to map the watcher’s creekside turn; does not know what the watcher is.
tl0015.voice: Observant and spare, describing tracks before drawing conclusions.
tl0015.line: I can show you a creekside route. Read the broken reeds and the stalker's turn; we can leave the lantern black and stay below its sightline.

responses.line: The tracks show where it turns. Without rope, I can't promise the streambank will hold under everyone's weight.
The rope gives us a handline at the shallow crossing. We can follow the tracks beneath the stalker's sightline.

choices.label: Read the creekside tracks
choices.reply: You and Ilya mark the shallow crossings. The streambed keeps you below the stalker's sightline without exposing the camp.

journal.text: Hunter Ilya found broken reeds showing the stalker's creekside patrol. The party can follow the stream to pass beneath its sightline without lighting the camp lantern.

tl0016.name: Waykeeper Sella
tl0016.role: Caretaker of the Mistwood trail markers
tl0016.goal: Keep the fork legible for travelers without claiming the old marker points to safe ground.
tl0016.knowledge: Knows the pale stones still lead toward the ruined watchpost; cannot date or identify the waystone's maker.
tl0016.voice: Measured and practical, careful to separate route knowledge from guesses.
tl0016.line: Last night's storm turned the center stone. Its old face has no name, only a worn notch. I won't choose a direction for every traveler.

choices.label: Set the waystone upright
choices.reply: You seat the marker in its socket. The pale stones now point toward the ruined watchpost; no maker's name survives.

choices.label: Leave the marker turned
choices.reply: You leave the stone as the storm turned it. The camp trail stays less visible, but the marker offers no direction.

tl0016.name: Carver Doma
tl0016.role: Stoneworker who maintains the old trail signs
tl0016.goal: Preserve the remaining cuts in the waystone and stop visitors from mistaking a route for a promise of safety.
tl0016.knowledge: Recognizes weather wear and the marker's socket, but does not know who carved its original notch.
tl0016.voice: Dry, exact, and skeptical of confident explanations.
tl0016.line: A notch can point toward a road. It cannot tell you what waits on it.

responses.line: The stone sits true again. Keep its worn notch; the old cut is all the direction we have.
You left it turned. Better an unread mark than a false promise of safe passage.

tl0002.name: Scout Tessa
tl0002.line: Pale stones mark the safe ground. The moss hides old snares, so watch where you step.

route_lines.1: Mara's ledger marked the pale stones correctly. We can skirt the ruined watchpost before the stalker finds us.
route_lines.2: Edmon's waywarden is already scouting ahead. Keep to the track while he draws the stalker off.

responses.line: Leora’s copied schedule gives me the patrol turn. I can lead the Waywarden clear of the stalker’s road.
The schedule stayed sealed. If the Waywarden comes, we will have to judge his patrol by what we see.
Inessa's copied rune index matches the pale stones. We can skirt the watchpost if the stalker is near.
The hunters' shuttered lantern marks the quiet bend. We can avoid the stalker's patrol if we stay on the pale stones.
We kept the camp concealed, but its lantern gives us no signal. Stay alert; the stalker's path is uncertain.

tl0002.goal: Lead the party along the safest known trail while limiting the watcher's opportunity to follow.
tl0002.knowledge: Knows the road, pale stones, and hunters' lantern signal; does not know the stalker's origin or intent.
tl0002.voice: Practical, alert, and economical with words.

tl0002.name: Lost Wayfarer
tl0002.line: Something circles the ruined watchpost. I heard it answer my name from the trees.
tl0002.goal: Warn other travellers about the presence circling the ruined watchpost.
tl0002.knowledge: Heard the stalker answer a name in the trees; cannot identify it or explain how it speaks.
tl0002.voice: Shaken and guarded, speaking in short sensory details.

tl0009.name: Courier Pell
tl0009.line: I found a charcoal rubbing under the watchpost stair. The western arch is marked, but the stalker kept me from carrying it onward.

responses.line: Tessa says you drove both creatures off the road. I can carry the rubbing onward now, and the watchpost stair is clear.

choices.label: Mark it for repair
choices.reply: Pell and Tessa mark the damaged stair for repair. She copies the western arch into her field book.

choices.label: Leave a warning
choices.reply: You leave a warning for the next traveller and keep the rubbing. The watchpost remains unsafe.

tl0009.goal: Deliver the charcoal rubbing and leave the watchpost safer for the next traveller.
tl0009.knowledge: Found the rubbing under the stair and knows the stalker blocked the route; has not reached Lorian.
tl0009.voice: Quick and matter-of-fact, focused on the message in hand.

tl0009.name: Courier Eren
tl0009.line: Maelin helped me carry the dispatch out of the flood. I still have to get it to the next courier.

responses.line: The handline kept the dispatch dry and brought us around the watched road. I can give Pell the route record.
I left the cart and carried the dispatch through the exposed ford. We still had to take the watched road.

tl0009.goal: Deliver the sealed route dispatch to Courier Pell at the watchpost.
tl0009.knowledge: Knows how the party crossed the river and that the dispatch must reach Courier Pell; cannot identify the stalker.
tl0009.voice: Grateful and precise, reporting the route without embellishing the record.

tl0009.name: Waywarden Saren
tl0009.line: Edmon's seal sent me to count the road markers. A patrol can guard a path, but only a traveller can decide where it leads.
tl0009.goal: Survey the markers under Edmon's seal without choosing the traveller's destination.
tl0009.knowledge: Knows the patrol route and royal orders; understands that guarding a road does not decide what it is for.
tl0009.voice: Disciplined and restrained, separating duty from judgment.

tl0003.name: Dorian the Seer
tl0003.line: I hid the scrolls because a road between worlds magnifies the purpose of whoever crosses it.

choices.label: Seek a road beyond this world
choices.reply: You tell Dorian that you seek a question worth carrying beyond this world, and will answer for the road you open.

choices.label: Understand world travel
choices.reply: You tell Dorian that you seek knowledge of world travel, and will not mistake understanding for mastery.

choices.label: Return the scrolls to Edmon
choices.reply: You tell Dorian that you will carry the scrolls back to King Edmon's court and answer for what they teach.

responses.line: Tessa's repaired watchpost marks the western arch. The scrolls will be easier to carry home without losing the return path.

tl0003.role: Seer and last keeper of the Byzantem scrolls
tl0003.goal: Test why Algoreth seeks the scrolls before allowing the vault story to proceed.
tl0003.knowledge: Knows he hid the scrolls and that world-travel magnifies the traveller's purpose; the available source does not establish his later history.
tl0003.voice: Cryptic but concise, asking the player to examine motive rather than accept a prophecy.

tl0003.name: Lorian Guardian
tl0003.line: The vault is not a prize. Prove you can leave its door closed before you ask it to open.

responses.line: You would carry a question through the arch. I will test the purpose you mean to take with you.
Knowledge can still open a door. Prove you understand the risk before asking this lock to yield.
You name a custodian and a return. The vault knows that promises are only beginnings.

tl0003.goal: Keep the vault closed until the traveller shows restraint.
tl0003.knowledge: Knows its duty and the vault warning; does not judge the wider history of the scrolls.
tl0003.voice: Impersonal and unwavering, speaking in terms of duty and proof.

tl0010.name: Gallery Keeper
tl0010.line: The three marks are passage, return, and restraint. Only one keeps a traveller from opening a gate for its own sake.

choices.label: Name restraint
choices.reply: The keeper accepts restraint as the answer. The gallery record can be carried without opening its sealed niches.

choices.label: Demand passage
choices.reply: The keeper refuses the demand. The sealed niches stay shut, and the warning remains unresolved.

tl0010.goal: Protect the sealed niches and make the three marks understandable to the traveller.
tl0010.knowledge: Knows the gallery marks passage, return, and restraint; will not reveal what lies behind unopened niches.
tl0010.voice: Patient and exact, treating the warning as a question.

tl0010.name: Dorian's Echo
tl0010.line: A warning is not a lock. It is a question the traveller must answer before choosing to cross.
tl0010.role: Echo bound to the gallery inscription
tl0010.goal: Make the traveller interpret the warning before choosing to cross.
tl0010.knowledge: Repeats the inscription's challenge but is not established as Dorian himself or as a complete record of his memory.
tl0010.voice: Reflective and spare, phrased as questions and cautions.

tl0004.name: King Edmon
tl0004.line: You have returned with the scrolls. Tell the court what they can do, and what they must not do.
tl0004.goal: Hear Algoreth's account and learn what the recovered scrolls can and cannot do.
tl0004.knowledge: Knows Algoreth returned with the scrolls after travelling under royal protection; he does not yet know what they contain.
tl0004.voice: Measured and authoritative, welcoming without promising what he cannot know.

tl0004.name: Queen Alisande
tl0004.line: Knowledge won in darkness deserves careful study. I will argue for patience before the nobles.
tl0004.goal: Protect the trust behind the expedition and ensure the scrolls are treated as a public responsibility.
tl0004.knowledge: Knows the court's obligations and the people affected by royal decisions; her knowledge of the road is limited to the records before her.
tl0004.voice: Warm, composed, and direct about responsibility.

responses.line: You left the sealed niches closed in Lorian. That restraint honors Edmon's trust while we study what the scrolls actually say.
The gallery warning remains unresolved. Before another gate is approached, the court should agree on what the scrolls may be used for.

tl0011.name: Captain Rovan
tl0011.line: The western road can be guarded, but soldiers cannot decide what a world-crossing spell is for.

choices.label: Keep the road open
choices.reply: Rovan will keep the road open for scholars and travellers under the court's watch.

choices.label: Restrict the scrolls
choices.reply: Rovan records the court's caution. Access to the scrolls will require the king and queen's leave.

tl0011.goal: Recommend a road policy the court can enforce without letting soldiers decide the scrolls' purpose.
tl0011.knowledge: Knows what the guard can protect and the limits of military authority; has not studied the scrolls.
tl0011.voice: Blunt, civic-minded, and wary of power without accountability.

tl0011.name: Queen Alisande
tl0011.line: Edmon and I will hear the witnesses before the court seals its account. The people who could be harmed deserve a voice.
tl0011.goal: Hear the witnesses with Edmon before the court decides how to safeguard the scrolls.
tl0011.knowledge: Knows the court must weigh public risk and the royal record; Edmon is her husband and the original king in this early period.
tl0011.voice: Warm, composed, and direct about responsibility.

tl0012.name: Warden Celene
tl0012.line: The breach repeats the king's last spoken thought. The ward lines hold, but the eastern stair is bending inward.

choices.label: Reinforce the ward
choices.reply: Celene strengthens the outer ward. It may hold through one more surge while the party descends.

choices.label: Record the pulse
choices.reply: Celene records the pulse without changing the ward. The pattern may help identify the echo below.

tl0012.goal: Keep the courtyard perimeter stable long enough for the party to investigate the vault.
tl0012.knowledge: Can reinforce the outer ward or record the pulse; cannot yet explain the voice beneath the academy.
tl0012.voice: Focused and urgent, reporting observable changes.

tl0012.name: Magister Vael
tl0012.line: I marked the pulse in the courtyard slate. The vault below answers in the same rhythm; we should descend before the next surge.

responses.line: Celene's reinforced ward gives us a narrow window. Descend before the next surge.
Celene's pulse record may reveal how the echo repeats. Descend and compare it with the vault.

tl0012.goal: Connect the courtyard pulse to the disturbance in the sealed vault.
tl0012.knowledge: Has measured the pulse and seen the vault react; the source of the echo remains unknown.
tl0012.voice: Scholarly and controlled, becoming terse when the ward is at risk.

tl0005.name: Magister Vael
tl0005.line: The observatory wards bend toward the breach. The sealed lecture vault is answering voices from below.
tl0005.goal: Connect the courtyard pulse to the disturbance in the sealed vault.
tl0005.knowledge: Has measured the pulse and seen the vault react; the source of the echo remains unknown.
tl0005.voice: Scholarly and controlled, becoming terse when the ward is at risk.

tl0005.name: Queen Alisande
tl0005.line: I will hold the wardens at the perimeter. Do not mistake the echo for a command.
tl0005.role: Queen of Alsperia and co-ruler beside Algoreth
tl0005.goal: Hold the academy perimeter while Algoreth investigates the echo beneath the vault.
tl0005.knowledge: Knows the Tear of Chaos is contained and the false Algoreth remains within it; the intervening years and the nature of other Tears remain unresolved.
tl0005.voice: Warm, composed, and direct about responsibility.

tl0021.name: Warden Celene
tl0021.line: The ring is stable for now. Force will only make the pulse answer harder. Before we descend, decide what rule the ward should keep.

choices.label: Set a boundary of form
choices.reply: Algoreth traces a fixed contour around the breach. Celene marks its shape and watches for any change.

choices.label: Name the ward's purpose
choices.reply: Algoreth defines the ward's purpose: contain and observe, without obeying the voice within.

tl0021.goal: Record a stable rule for containing the breach before anyone enters the vault.
tl0021.knowledge: The breach responds to force and repeats the king's last spoken thought; its source and intent remain unknown.
tl0021.voice: Focused and urgent, grounded in measurements rather than speculation.

tl0021.name: Magister Vael
tl0021.line: The courtyard pulse ends here. If we descend, we should carry a rule that can be observed and checked.

responses.line: Celene has marked the boundary of form. I will compare that contour with every change in the vault.
The ward's purpose is containment and observation. We will record what the voice does, without treating it as an instruction.

tl0021.goal: Carry the selected warding rule into the vault and compare it with observable changes.
tl0021.knowledge: Has measured the courtyard pulse and annex breach; does not know what speaks from the Tear.
tl0021.voice: Scholarly and controlled, careful to separate evidence from interpretation.

tl0006.name: Ealdrin
tl0006.line: This living record says a Tear may answer a powerful mind that questions its own limits.
tl0006.goal: Compare the archive record with the Eldrador signs without treating either as a settled explanation.
tl0006.knowledge: Knows the surviving account links powers to questions about their limits; does not know whether the Deep and Eternal Archives are the same place.
tl0006.voice: Thoughtful and skeptical, separating evidence from interpretation.

tl0006.name: Queen Alisande
tl0006.line: We need scholars and warders before we follow the second Tear. I will not leave the record unread.
tl0006.role: Queen of Alsperia and co-ruler beside Algoreth
tl0006.goal: Keep the research into other Tears supported by scholars and warders, and remain with Algoreth.
tl0006.knowledge: Knows the Tear of Chaos is contained and the false Algoreth remains within it; the intervening years and the nature of other Tears remain unresolved.
tl0006.voice: Warm, composed, and direct about responsibility.

tl0006.name: Archivist Nera
tl0006.line: The living record and its witness are catalogued, but the comparison leaf is not. We can call the Index Warden to test the gap or leave the folio sealed.

choices.label: Call the Index Warden
choices.reply: Nera calls the Warden to witness the missing leaf. The seal remains closed; the answer must be earned from its keeper.

choices.label: Leave the folio sealed
choices.reply: You leave the dormant ward intact. The missing leaf stays an unanswered question, and Selene can prepare the witness account.

tl0006.goal: Protect the sealed account while helping Ealdrin distinguish the catalog gap from a conclusion about the Tears.
tl0006.knowledge: Knows the comparison leaf is absent and that the Index Warden guards unindexed folios; does not know what the missing leaf would prove.
tl0006.voice: Precise and patient, treating missing evidence as a question rather than a verdict.

tl0006.name: Index Warden
tl0006.line: The sealed account remains in order. No witness is called while the folio rests undisturbed.
tl0006.role: Keeper of the Deep Archive index wards
tl0006.goal: Guard the unindexed folios without exposing the sealed account to an untested inquiry.
tl0006.knowledge: Knows the missing comparison leaf is held among the unindexed folios; cannot explain what it would establish about other Tears.
tl0006.voice: Formal and measured, speaking only to the limits of its record.

responses.line: You called me to witness the missing comparison. The account remains sealed; answer the test, and I will yield the leaf.

tl0007.name: Queen Vaelthira
tl0007.line: My sanctuary's Tear speaks with a familiar voice. I ask you to study it before choosing what to do.

responses.line: Your copied archive account may help us compare the sanctuary signs. I will tell you what our wardens have observed.
You chose to preserve the original and question its witness. I will answer what our wardens have observed directly.

tl0007.goal: Invite a careful investigation of the sanctuary Tear before anyone decides how to respond.
tl0007.knowledge: Knows what her wardens observed and that the Tear speaks with a familiar voice; its cause and outcome remain unknown.
tl0007.voice: Regal and deliberate, asking for study before action.

tl0007.name: Seraphina Everglow
tl0007.line: The ward diagrams are ready. We can observe the Tear without provoking it.

responses.line: The archive copy is aboard. I will keep it separate from the instruments until we can compare the signs.
The original remains safe in Alsperia. I have space aboard for our notes from the witness.

tl0007.goal: Prepare instruments and ward diagrams while leaving room to change course after seeing the Tear.
tl0007.knowledge: Knows the diagrams and instruments aboard the ship; has not examined Eldrador's Tear directly.
tl0007.voice: Clear and reassuring, giving practical details without claiming certainty.

tl0013.name: Archivist Selene
tl0013.line: The index names a sealed account and a living witness. I can copy the account, or keep the original safe while Ealdrin questions me.

choices.label: Copy the sealed account
choices.reply: Selene prepares a travel copy. Ealdrin can compare its wording with what the Eldrador wardens report.

choices.label: Question the witness
choices.reply: Selene keeps the original safe and gives Ealdrin her account. The expedition will rely on questions asked in Eldrador.

tl0013.goal: Protect the original sealed account while helping Ealdrin prepare a responsible copy or witness record.
tl0013.knowledge: Knows the index entry and the living witness; does not claim the account resolves the nature of the Tears.
tl0013.voice: Careful and protective of fragile records.

responses.line: Nera called the Index Warden to testify. I can prepare the witness record while Ealdrin compares the recovered catalog leaf.
Nera left the folio sealed. I will preserve the account and prepare the living witness statement for Ealdrin.

tl0013.name: Ealdrin
tl0013.line: An archive record can shape a question, but it cannot tell us what another Tear means. We must listen when we arrive.
tl0013.goal: Choose a responsible way to prepare the Index Hall record for the Eldrador inquiry.
tl0013.knowledge: Knows the index names a sealed account and a living witness; he will compare either source with the Eldrador signs.
tl0013.voice: Thoughtful and skeptical, separating evidence from interpretation.

responses.line: The Warden yielded the comparison leaf but no verdict. It records the catalog gap; the living witness still matters.
The folio remains sealed. We will keep the missing comparison as an open question and rely on Selene’s witness account.

tl0017.name: Stablemaster Edda
tl0017.line: The king's horse and map are ready. Choose whether the pack carries shuttered lantern oil or rope and trail rations.

choices.label: Pack shuttered lantern oil
choices.reply: Edda packs a hooded lantern and spare oil. Tessa can signal from cover, but the choice to light it remains yours.

choices.label: Take rope and trail rations
choices.reply: Tavin packs braided rope and trail rations. Ilya can secure the creek crossing without exposing the camp to a light.

tl0017.goal: Prepare Edmon's promised horse and one useful field kit for the expedition.
tl0017.knowledge: Knows the stables' available travel supplies and the horse's condition; has not travelled through the Mistwood herself.
tl0017.voice: Competent and concise, focused on practical trade-offs.

tl0017.name: Groom Tavin
tl0017.line: Rope helps where the path narrows. A lantern helps only if its bearer chooses when to show it.

responses.line: The spare oil is packed. Keep the shutter closed until Tessa says a signal can help.
The rope and rations are packed. If the creek tracks hold, Ilya can guide the party across without a signal.

tl0017.goal: Make sure the expedition's supplies match the route it intends to take.
tl0017.knowledge: Knows how to pack and handle horses, lanterns, and rope; has only hearsay about the Mistwood trail.
tl0017.voice: Friendly and direct, comfortable admitting what he has not seen.

tl0014.name: Flight Marshal Aven
tl0014.line: We can tune the ship for a quiet approach or load the warding instruments first. Both preparations leave the sanctuary itself unknown.

choices.label: Prioritize observation
choices.reply: Aven prepares a quiet approach and carries Selene’s copied account. The warding array stays in reserve.

choices.label: Prioritize protection
choices.reply: Aven loads the warding instruments for a guarded arrival. Selene’s original account stays in the court vault.

tl0014.goal: Prepare the ship for either a quiet observation approach or a guarded arrival.
tl0014.knowledge: Knows the ship and its instruments; cannot predict what the Eldrador sanctuary will require.
tl0014.voice: Practical, calm, and explicit about trade-offs.

responses.line: The copied account is aboard in a separate case and marked incomplete. I will keep it away from the warding array until the signs can be compared.
Ealdrin carries Selene’s witness notes; the sealed account stays in Alsperia. I will prepare for an inquiry guided by Eldrador’s testimony.

tl0014.name: Seraphina Everglow
tl0014.line: The crew is ready. We leave with questions, records, and room to change our minds when we see the Tear.

responses.line: Aven has tuned the ship for observation. We will watch before we interfere.
Aven has loaded the warding instruments. We will arrive prepared to protect the crew.

tl0014.goal: Prepare instruments and ward diagrams while leaving room to change course after seeing the Tear.
tl0014.knowledge: Knows the diagrams and instruments aboard the ship; has not examined Eldrador's Tear directly.
tl0014.voice: Clear and reassuring, giving practical details without claiming certainty.

tl0018.name: Archivist Leora
tl0018.line: The west-road patrol schedule is current. I can copy it for the journey, or keep the sealed original here.

choices.label: Copy the patrol schedule
choices.reply: Leora copies the current watchpost patrol turn onto a travel sheet. The original stays sealed in the archive.

choices.label: Leave the schedule sealed
choices.reply: You leave the dispatch under crown seal. The Waywarden may still meet you, but you have no copy of his patrol timing.

tl0018.goal: Protect the original patrol record while preparing the expedition to travel under the crown’s authority.
tl0018.knowledge: Knows the current patrol schedule and its authorized copy rules; does not know what waits in Mistwood.
tl0018.voice: Careful and procedural, balancing public safety with protection of royal records.

tl0018.name: Page Nerin
tl0018.line: The patrol turns at the old watchpost. The map table shows where a lawful diversion could draw danger away from the road.

responses.line: With the schedule copied, Tessa can time the Waywarden’s patrol to clear the stalker’s road.
Without a copy, the patrol timing remains a guess. Do not promise the road will be clear.

tl0018.goal: Keep the archive’s field maps legible and help authorized travellers understand the patrol marks.
tl0018.knowledge: Knows the map table’s route marks and where schedules are stored; has not travelled west himself.
tl0018.voice: Curious and clear, eager to explain what a map can and cannot prove.

tl0019.name: Fordkeeper Maelin
tl0019.line: The current has taken the bridge pins. I can walk you over the pale stones, or help you rig a handline if you brought rope.

choices.label: Rig the rope handline
choices.reply: You set the expedition rope across the current. If it reaches the far bank, Eren can save his dispatch with the cart.

choices.label: Guide Eren over the stepping stones
choices.reply: You guide Eren over the shallow stones and leave the loaded cart above the water. The crossing is exposed, but no one is left on the far bank.

tl0019.goal: Keep travellers and couriers from being swept into the flooded crossing.
tl0019.knowledge: Knows the ford, the exposed stepping stones, and where a handline can be secured; does not know what hunts the road.
tl0019.voice: Practical and watchful, giving a clear warning before offering a route.

tl0019.name: Courier Eren
tl0019.line: The dispatch is sealed against water. It records the road, not what waits along it.

responses.line: The rope will bring my cart and dispatch across, if it holds.
Leave the cart. I can carry the dispatch over the stones.

tl0019.goal: Carry a sealed route dispatch to the Ruined Watchpost without losing it to the flood.
tl0019.knowledge: Knows the dispatch concerns the road and patrol markers; has not read it or met the stalker.
tl0019.voice: Urgent but composed, distinguishing what the document says from what it does not.

tl0020.name: Ealdrin
tl0020.line: Selene’s account gives us evidence and a witness, but no conclusion about the Eldrador Tear.

choices.label: Carry the marked copy
choices.reply: We will carry Selene’s copy sealed apart from the instruments and mark its limits clearly.

choices.label: Carry the witness notes
choices.reply: We will leave the copy in Alsperia and carry Selene’s witness notes instead.

tl0020.goal: Help Algoreth choose how the expedition handles incomplete archival evidence.
tl0020.knowledge: Knows Selene’s account and witness notes; neither establishes the cause or nature of the Eldrador Tear.
tl0020.voice: Thoughtful and skeptical, distinguishing the record from its interpretation.

responses.line: The Index Warden yielded a comparison leaf, not a verdict. I will carry that distinction into Eldrador.
Nera kept the folio sealed. We will preserve that choice and carry only the witness account if you decide.

tl0020.name: Seraphina Everglow
tl0020.line: The diagrams are ready. I will keep the listening instruments apart from whichever record you choose.

responses.line: The copied account is secured in its own case, clearly marked as incomplete.
The archive copy remains here. I have made room for Selene’s witness notes and our own observations.

tl0020.goal: Pack the ward diagrams and listening instruments without letting assumptions shape the investigation.
tl0020.knowledge: Knows the instruments and ward diagrams; has not examined Eldrador’s Tear directly.
tl0020.voice: Clear and reassuring, with practical details and no claims of certainty.

tl0020.name: Queen Alisande
tl0020.line: We will bring what helps us ask careful questions, and leave room for the people who know their sanctuary.
tl0020.role: Queen of Alsperia and co-ruler beside Algoreth
tl0020.goal: Keep the expedition open to Eldrador’s witnesses while supporting Algoreth’s decision.
tl0020.knowledge: Knows the party is preparing to investigate another Tear; its nature and outcome remain unknown.
tl0020.voice: Warm, composed, and direct about shared responsibility.
